task_contract.goal: Reject duplicate inventory SKUs after canonical normalization.
exclusions: Do not special-case only an identical raw spelling.
acceptance_conditions: Whitespace/case-equivalent duplicate SKUs are also rejected.

evidence.claim: The normalized dictionary assignment overwrites an existing canonical SKU.
The shadow case differs in raw spelling but has the same canonical SKU.

localization.failure_or_requirement: Canonical duplicate SKUs must not overwrite earlier quantities.
localization.why_this_location: This loop creates the canonical key and performs the overwriting write.
localization.why_not_obvious_alternatives: Callers do not own canonicalization, and raw-input checks miss equivalent spellings.

hypotheses.statement: Duplicate loss occurs because canonical-key membership is never checked before assignment.
hypotheses.falsifier: If membership is already checked on the canonical key before assignment, this hypothesis is false.
hypotheses.expected_observation_if_true: A pre-assignment canonical-key check makes exact and equivalent duplicates raise ValueError.

items.expected_effect: Reject a repeated canonical key before it can overwrite state.
items.risk: Unexpectedly rejects inputs that callers previously allowed to overwrite.
